name: datasetList.py
summary: DRF serializer that converts Dataset model instances into lightweight JSON representations optimized for list endpoints.
purpose: Exists to provide a performant, read-focused serialization contract for dataset collections, separating list-view concerns from detailed dataset representations and preventing heavy field serialization in high-volume endpoints.
responsibilities: Serialize Dataset model instances into primitive Python datatypes suitable for JSON rendering
Expose a curated subset of Dataset fields appropriate for list views
Validate and transform incoming data if used for write operations
Enforce a stable API contract between the domain model and the presentation layer
inputs: Optional DRF request context passed from the view layer
outputs: OrderedDict / JSON-compatible dictionary representation of dataset fields
List of serialized dataset records when instantiated with many=True
architecture_notes: Implements the Django REST Framework Serializer pattern as part of a layered backend architecture. It serves as an anti-corruption layer between the Dataset domain model and the API surface, ensuring list endpoints remain performant by avoiding deeply nested or computationally expensive fields. Typically consumed by dataset/views.py in a ListAPIView or ViewSet. The 'List' suffix implies a companion detail serializer should exist or be introduced to handle full resource representations, following the CQRS-like separation of read models for list versus detail views.
improvements: Explicitly declare Meta.fields rather than using '__all__' to prevent accidental leakage of internal or sensitive model fields
Add type hints to custom methods and override to_representation if custom logic is present
Include docstrings and comments explaining the field selection rationale for list views
Declare read-only fields explicitly (read_only=True) to optimize validation overhead for list endpoints
Consider adding a hyperlinked identity field or resource URL to improve HATEOAS support
